_comment: Cases the engine does not match yet (cause: engine-gap). `run` reports a listed case as a CTest skip while it still differs and fails once it matches, so the entry is removed together with the fix.

gaps.c4_calcfield_ref_renamed: calculated field whose referenced source field was renamed: Excel drops the data field and re-lays out the pivot; the engine keeps it
gaps.d3_getpivotdata: GETPIVOTDATA cells over the refreshed pivot keep pre-refresh values / #REF! instead of Excel's refreshed results
gaps.d4_two_pivots_one_cache: second pivot sharing the refreshed cache is not re-rendered; stale cells A5:A8 remain
gaps.en_hdr_blank: cacheField for a blank or empty-string source header is written without Excel's caption attribute
